title: Gelatile
tagline: Swipe to merge twin jellies, read the board's targets a move ahead and reach the big tile

fr.tagline: Fusionne les gelées jumelles, déjoue les pièges qui visent la grille et fais grimper la tuile jusqu'à 2048. Plusieurs pouvoirs viennent pimenter les parties au travers de 5 biomes.

en.tagline: Merge twin jellies, outsmart the traps aiming at the grid and climb the tile all the way to 2048. Several powers spice up your games across 5 biomes.

description: Gelatile is a merge puzzle on a 4x4 board of jelly tiles. Swipe to slide every tile one way: two twins that meet stamp into their sum, and from 128 up a tile turns gold, then rainbow. Each of the thirty levels asks for one tile, from 128 to 2048, starting from a board already laid out in a corner, with a par of moves for the second star and a bonus for the third. Fourteen powers join the board one at a time across five biomes - a bubble bath, a jungle lodge, a crystal cave, rice terraces and a coconut beach. Tile powers freeze, petrify, ghost or hide a tile for five moves. Targets mark cells of the grid and strike after your next move, so you choose which tile lands there. And a side of the board can turn into a portal or lock shut.

fr.tagline: Glisse pour fusionner les tuiles identiques afin d'atteindre ton objectif
